title: Private game defaults; next explicit parent only
description: Native input is limited to 4096 bytes, rejects duplicate/unknown fields, and requires unsigned integer tokens. Saving grants no runtime authority. Ordinary startup currently refuses non-off modes until qualified safety and worker binding are available.

target_executable.description: One exact ASCII basename, not a path, substring or launcher expansion. Empty is allowed only when off. This private value is not a public status field.

target_scope.description: Explicit adapter; no cross-platform fallback. Missing-file defaults select the native adapter without scanning.
